lessons.title: Je grandis chaque jour
lessons.oneGoal: Students understand that growing and changing is natural and positive

opening.activity: Welcome circle: Point to classroom growth chart. Ask 'Est-ce que vous grandissez?' Show height comparison from September photos.

main.activity: Growth exploration station: Students compare baby items (small shoes, bottles) with big kid items. Practice saying 'Je grandis' with growth gestures. Create simple growth timeline with pictures.

closing.activity: Circle time: Each student says one thing they can do now that babies can't. End with growth chant: 'Je grandis, tu grandis, nous grandissons ensemble!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students recognize daily changes in themselves (height, skills, knowledge)

lessons.title: Mes changements spéciaux
lessons.oneGoal: Students identify personal changes they've experienced and feel proud of them

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 1: Review growth chant. Show mystery box with 'special growth moments' cards inside.

main.activity: Special changes gallery walk: Students draw or bring photos showing something new they learned this year. Practice 'Je suis fier de...' with proud gesture. Create 'My Special Changes' book page.

closing.activity: Proud parade: Students walk around room showing their change picture while others cheer. Practice proud feeling gesture together.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Children recognize their own achievements (walking, talking, reading first words)

lessons.title: Célébrer nos familles
lessons.oneGoal: Students appreciate how families celebrate milestones and traditions together

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 2: Review proud feelings. Introduce celebration dance moves. Ask 'Comment votre famille célèbre?'

main.activity: Family celebration stations: Students rotate through birthday station (party hats), holiday station (decorations), tradition station (cultural items). Practice celebration vocabulary with actions. Create family celebration card.

closing.activity: Celebration circle: Students share one family celebration using their card. End with group celebration dance combining all cultures represented.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students connect to birthdays, holidays, and special family moments

lessons.title: Mes souvenirs de bébé
lessons.oneGoal: Students compare their baby selves to now, recognizing tremendous growth

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 3: Review family celebrations. Show baby doll and ask 'Qu'est-ce qu'un bébé peut faire?' vs. 'Qu'est-ce que vous pouvez faire?'

main.activity: Then and now comparison: Students create two-column poster showing baby abilities vs. current abilities. Use baby items for tactile comparison. Practice time vocabulary with 'avant/maintenant' gestures. Photo storytelling with baby pictures.

closing.activity: Growth appreciation circle: Each student shares one amazing thing they can do now. Celebrate with 'We've grown so much!' song with actions.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students see baby photos and understand their incredible development journey

lessons.title: Mes amis changent aussi
lessons.oneGoal: Students recognize that their friends are also growing and changing

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 4: Review individual growth. Play 'Spot the Changes' game with classroom photos from beginning of year.

main.activity: Friend growth detective: Students work in pairs with observation sheets, looking for positive changes in each other (skills, interests, height). Create 'My Friend is Growing' certificates. Practice compliment vocabulary with kind gesture.

closing.activity: Friend celebration: Students present certificates to partners. Group chant: 'We're all growing together!' with friendship hand gestures.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students notice friends' new skills, interests, and physical growth

lessons.title: Mes rêves pour grandir
lessons.oneGoal: Students express hopes and dreams for their future growth

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 5: Review friend growth. Share teacher's childhood dream and current reality. Ask 'Quels sont vos rêves?'

main.activity: Dream visualization: Students create dream boards with pictures/drawings of future goals. Practice dream vocabulary with reaching gestures. Share dreams in small groups. Create 'My Growth Dreams' journal page.

closing.activity: Dream circle: Students share one dream using 'Je veux...' sentence starter. End with dream-reaching dance (arms stretching up).

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students think about what they want to learn or become

lessons.title: Nos traditions de classe
lessons.oneGoal: Students create and appreciate classroom traditions that bring the community together

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 6: Review dreams for growth. Show photos of current classroom traditions. Ask 'What makes our class special together?'

main.activity: Tradition creation stations: Students rotate through greeting station (create special handshakes), celebration station (design class cheers), community helper station (establish helping traditions). Vote on favorites to implement daily.

closing.activity: New tradition inauguration: Practice chosen class tradition together. Create visual reminder poster for daily use.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students participate in daily routines and special class celebrations

lessons.title: Capsule temporelle
lessons.oneGoal: Students create a time capsule documenting their current selves for future reflection

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 7: Review class traditions. Show mystery box and explain time capsule concept with 'message to future you'.

main.activity: Time capsule creation: Students choose 3-4 items representing current self (drawing, photo, favorite item, letter to future self). Practice time vocabulary with past/present/future gestures. Seal items in individual containers.

closing.activity: Capsule ceremony: Students share one item from capsule before sealing. Plan opening date (end of Grade 1). Store ceremonially in special class location.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students preserve current memories and interests to revisit later

lessons.title: Histoires de famille
lessons.oneGoal: Students share and listen to meaningful family stories about growth and milestones

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 8: Review time capsule excitement. Share teacher's family growth story with photos. Introduce listening posture and storytelling voice.

main.activity: Family story sharing circle: Students take turns sharing family stories about milestones (first steps, birthdays, achievements). Use story props or photos if available. Practice listening skills with active listening gestures. Record special stories in class memory book.

closing.activity: Story appreciation: Students share favorite story they heard. Practice storytelling ending: 'Et voilà mon histoire!' with proud gesture.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students learn about family history and meaningful family moments

lessons.title: Mes moments de fierté
lessons.oneGoal: Students identify and celebrate moments when they felt proud of their growth

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 9: Review family stories. Demonstrate proud feeling with posture and expression. Ask 'When do you feel proud?'

main.activity: Pride moment gallery: Students create pride moment displays showing times they felt proud of growth (learning to read, helping others, trying something new). Practice pride vocabulary with confident gestures. Create individual pride books with illustrations.

closing.activity: Pride celebration walk: Students walk proudly around room sharing one pride moment. Group cheer: 'We are proud of our growth!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students connect to learning to ride bikes, helping others, solving problems

lessons.title: Grandir ensemble à l'école
lessons.oneGoal: Students understand how the school community supports everyone's growth

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 10: Review individual pride moments. Take mini school walk, pointing out all the people who help students grow.

main.activity: School community appreciation: Students create thank you cards for different school helpers (teachers, principal, custodian, secretary). Practice support vocabulary with helping gestures. Role-play how different people help students learn and grow.

closing.activity: Helper appreciation: Students deliver thank you cards to school helpers if possible. Practice gratitude expression: 'Merci de m'aider à grandir!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students recognize teachers, principals, and peers who help them grow

lessons.title: Célébrer nos apprentissages
lessons.oneGoal: Students recognize and celebrate the learning growth they've made this year

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 11: Review school community support. Show student work samples from September vs. now. Celebrate obvious improvements.

main.activity: Learning growth showcase: Students compare their work from beginning of year to current work in different subjects. Create learning progress posters showing improvement. Practice celebration vocabulary with achievement dances. Self-assessment using simple progress indicators.

closing.activity: Learning celebration parade: Students march around room holding progress posters. Group chant: 'Look how much we've learned!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students see improvement in reading, math, social skills, and independence

lessons.title: Portfolio de croissance
lessons.oneGoal: Students compile evidence of their growth throughout the year in a personal portfolio

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 12: Review learning celebrations. Introduce portfolio concept as 'special collection of your growth journey'.

main.activity: Portfolio assembly: Students select and organize work samples, photos, and reflections showing their year-long growth. Include items from time capsule activity, pride moments, and learning celebrations. Add reflection labels explaining growth shown in each item.

closing.activity: Portfolio preview: Students share one favorite portfolio item with a partner. Practice portfolio presentation vocabulary for next lesson.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students create a keepsake showing their journey from beginning to end of year

lessons.title: Présentation de croissance
lessons.oneGoal: Students present their growth journey to others, demonstrating confidence in their development

opening.activity: Builds on Lesson 13: Review completed portfolios. Practice presentation voice and confident posture. Set up supportive audience expectations.

main.activity: Growth journey presentations: Students present their portfolios to audience (family, other classes, or peers), sharing their growth story from beginning to end of year. Use presentation supports like sentence starters and visual cues. Audience practices appreciation responses.

closing.activity: Presentation celebration: Audience members share appreciations for each presenter. Students reflect on pride in sharing their growth journey.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students practice public speaking while celebrating personal achievements

lessons.title: Jeu de mémoire de croissance
lessons.oneGoal: Students reinforce growth vocabulary and concepts through engaging games

opening.activity: Extension activity building on all previous lessons through interactive vocabulary practice

main.activity: Growth vocabulary games rotation: Memory matching with growth concept cards, charades with growth actions, vocabulary bingo with unit terms, 'Simon Says' with growth movements. Students rotate through stations practicing key vocabulary from entire unit.

closing.activity: Game celebration: Students vote on favorite growth game. Practice all growth vocabulary with actions one final time.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students play games that reinforce learning in fun, social contexts

lessons.title: Art de croissance créatif
lessons.oneGoal: Students express their growth journey through creative art projects

opening.activity: Extension activity building on portfolio concept through artistic expression of growth

main.activity: Growth art creation: Students create artistic representations of their growth journey using various media (painting growth trees, collage timelines, sculpture of growth stages, handprint art showing progress). Focus on personal expression rather than technical skill.

closing.activity: Art gallery walk: Students display and appreciate each other's growth art. Practice art appreciation vocabulary.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students use art to communicate feelings and experiences about growing up

lessons.title: Théâtre de traditions familiales
lessons.oneGoal: Students act out family traditions, deepening understanding of cultural celebrations

opening.activity: Extension activity building on Lesson 3 and 9 through dramatic exploration of family traditions

main.activity: Family tradition theater: Students work in small groups to act out different family traditions (birthday celebrations, holiday customs, cultural ceremonies). Use simple costumes and props. Practice dramatic expression and cultural appreciation.

closing.activity: Tradition theater festival: Groups perform for each other. Audience practices respectful appreciation of all cultural traditions.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students embody family celebrations and share cultural practices

lessons.title: Livre de classe collectif
lessons.oneGoal: Students collaborate to create a class book celebrating everyone's growth stories

opening.activity: Extension activity combining elements from multiple lessons into a collaborative celebration

main.activity: Class book creation: Students work together to create a collective book about their class growth journey. Each student contributes a page showing their growth, plus group pages about class traditions, friendships, and shared learning. Combine text, drawings, and photos.

closing.activity: Book dedication ceremony: Students sign the completed class book and decide where it will be displayed or stored for future classes.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students create a lasting record of their shared classroom community growth

lessons.title: Fête de croissance
lessons.oneGoal: Students celebrate their growth journey with a culminating community celebration

opening.activity: Extension activity bringing together all unit concepts in a joyful community celebration

main.activity: Growth celebration festival: Students host a celebration including displays of growth portfolios, performance of class traditions, sharing of time capsule predictions, presentation of class book, and appreciation ceremony. Include music, food, and decorations representing class growth journey.

closing.activity: Celebration reflection: Students share favorite moments from celebration and express gratitude for growth journey together.

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students experience the joy of shared celebration and community recognition

lessons.title: Réflexion sur notre voyage
lessons.oneGoal: Students reflect on their complete learning journey and look forward to continued growth

opening.activity: Final extension activity helping students synthesize all learning and project forward

main.activity: Growth journey reflection: Students complete comprehensive reflection on their entire growth journey using pictures, words, and drawings. Create 'Future Me' vision including goals for Grade 2. Write letters to future selves. Practice gratitude for growth journey and excitement for continued growing.

closing.activity: Journey appreciation circle: Students share one favorite memory from the growth unit and one goal for future growth. End with final group chant: 'We grew, we learned, we celebrated together!'

lessons.realWorldConnection: Students understand that growth is ongoing and look forward to summer and Grade 2
